title: DonutSMP Auction Sniper
description: Automatically buys cheap Items on the Auction for Profit on DonutSMP
body:
# Auction Sniper

Auction Sniper automatically refreshes the DonutSMP auction house, searches for an exact target item below your configured maximum price, and immediately clicks the cheapest matching listing.

Configure the target item, maximum price, and start/stop keybind with `/auctionsniper`. The mod can also check and automatically enable DonutSMP's Auction Quick Buy setting before starting.

## Important

- Designed only for DonutSMP.
- Client-side mod.
- Requires Fabric API.
- Use at your own risk. Automated auction actions may result in unintended purchases or server moderation.

## Features

- Event-driven auction scanning after server inventory updates.
- Exact item ID and displayed-name matching.
- Maximum-price filtering with support for prices such as `$ 9.9k`, `$ 2m`, `$ 1.5b`, and `$ 1t`.
- Automatically clicks the cheapest matching listing.
- Configurable start/stop keybind.
- Optional automatic Auction Quick Buy enablement.
